title: Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager (Remote)
description:
Overview

MonetizeMore is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

If you think you are a good fit to join the MonetizeMore team, please fill out the application. Also, give specific reasons on what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality ;)

Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance. With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy. We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co-founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As an Operations Analyst at Crown, you will be responsible for the day‑to‑day execution of all onboarded clients activity. You will oversee the transaction lifecycle, from minting and redemption of stablecoins to managing client support and responding to operational inquiries. This role demands meticulous attention to detail, adherence to strict security protocols, and a process‑driven mindset to ensure the integrity of our operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and monitor all client virtual asset transactions using our institutional custody platform and apply our Transaction Policy Engine rules.
  • Oversee the daily flow of mint and redeem orders, processing BRL deposits and withdrawals while ensuring strict adherence to our rules.
  • Perform daily reconciliation of the on‑chain token supply against the funds held in our segregated reserve accounts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for institutional clients regarding all post‑onboarding operational matters.
  • Act as the first responder for operational alerts, investigate root cause, resolve the issue, and communicate with the client as needed.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, or control gaps and collaborate with technology and compliance teams to design and implement improvements.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You have 3+ years of experience in financial operations, treasury operations, payments, or a "back office" role, preferably at a VASP, fintech, or regulated institution.
  • You are exceptionally detail‑oriented and process‑driven, comfortable following complex procedures.
  • You have a foundational understanding of blockchain technology, including wallets, addresses, and transaction lifecycles.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English and can communicate clearly and professionally with sophisticated institutional clients.
  • You are resilient and emotionally intelligent, maintaining perfect task execution even under pressure.
  • You thrive in ownership‑driven environments and take accountability for your work.
  • You work effectively with Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design – we don’t hire layers of managers.

  • Collaboration is default – problems are shared property.

Gerdau Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)
description:
At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About the Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics.
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code.
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition.
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals).
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency).
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors.
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors.
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot.
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable.
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus).
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging.
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving.
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup).
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints.
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte).
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines.
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object.
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards.
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT.
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus.

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours.
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network.
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget.

FIFA has created a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Partnership Manager will be responsible for managing and delivering FIFA’s commercial partner rights at the local level, ensuring seamless coordination with the global FIFA Partnership Management team in Zurich. This includes day‑to‑day relationship management, operational delivery at venues and events where required, and strategic alignment with partner objectives within the host country and region.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proactively lead and foster relationships with FIFA Commercial Partners operating in Brazil, ensuring consistent, high-quality servicing in line with global standards.
  • Act as the key local point of contact for assigned Commercial Partner, ensuring continuous alignment and close collaboration with the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich to maintain consistent servicing and delivery across all touchpoints.
  • Lead assigned partnership projects and deliverables related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ in Brazil, ensuring on‑time, in‑scope, and on‑budget execution while identifying meaningful, locally relevant business and marketing opportunities that enhance partner impact and remain aligned with FIFA’s global partnership and brand strategy.

  • Track and manage local partner budgets and support reconciliation processes in close coordination with the Zurich Partnerships team.
  • Prepare and lead meetings and updates with internal and external stakeholders, including regular reporting to the Partnership Management team at FIFA Zurich.
  • Provide solution‑oriented, proactive support to the Head of Commercial Partnerships in Brazil and contribute to a unified servicing approach across global and local workstreams.
  • Support continuous improvement by feeding local market insights and operational learnings into FIFA’s global partnership tools and client servicing frameworks.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree required, preferably in Business, Marketing, Sports Management, or a related field
  • A solid understanding of the business of sports, marketing, and sponsorship rights delivery
  • Project and event management experience, ideally in an international environment

  • Team‑oriented, service‑minded, and collaborative across functions

  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing multiple priorities and deadlines

  • High level of professionalism, empathy, and commercial awareness
  • Strong representation skills, both internally and externally
  • Right to work in Brazil.

description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Compensation: $1440-$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400-$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Finance Case + bonus assignment

  3. Second Interview

  4. Valuation Case Test

  5. Final Interview

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation‑first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive success for users of Ubuntu and our open‑source products.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services, running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you will drive operations automation—using IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products—to both private and public clouds.

You will also improve Canonical products and open‑source technologies by providing feedback, writing bugs, or contributing pull requests, and collaborate on design and implementation with other teams.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation and Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Collaborate closely with the IS architect to align solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply IaC experience to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS, constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re‑usability and consistency across private and public clouds, considering distributed systems complexities
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation; set up and use observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design and maintain monitoring and alerting
  • Assist and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Receive uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share experience, know‑how, and best practices with team members in design sessions, mentorship and collaborative work
  • Take final responsibility for time‑critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by IaC across private and public clouds
  • A product mindset, thriving to develop products rather than solutions
  • Python software development experience with large projects
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to databases
  • Hands‑on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Excellent communication in English across email, chat, video or voice calls and in person
  • Motivated to troubleshoot from kernel to web and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • Willingness to be flexible and learn new ideas quickly
  • Passion for fast‑changing environments
  • Comfortable working within distributed teams
  • Passionate about open‑source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2 000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team member assistance program & wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the publisher of Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we must be the best.

Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Cargo: DESENVOLVEDOR SR Já pensou em trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas de Tecnologia do Brasil? Então a CAST é o lugar certo para você Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas Local de Atuação: Porto Alegre- RS Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto O QUE BUSCAMOS Se você tem experiência sólida em desenvolvimento PHP, para atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas web robustos, escaláveis e seguros, alinhados às necessidades estratégicas. Que possua conhecimentos e experiências em: Conhecimento do Sistema Eletrônico de Informações (SEI). Experiência com microsserviços, Docker, RabbitMQ e Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure). Vivência com bancos NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB. Experiência em testes automatizados e integração contínua. BENEFÍCIOS PARA TODOS Recarregue suas energias com auxílio alimentação. Facilitamos seu caminho para o trabalho com nosso vale-transporte. Cuidar de você é nosso compromisso: plano de saúde para sua tranquilidade. Cuidar de quem cuida é essencial Nossas mamães recebem um Kit Maternidade Castlovers, preparado com carinho para celebrar a chegada do bebê. BENEFÍCIOS PARA VOCÊ ESCOLHER Sorria com confiança: nosso plano odontológico cuida do seu bem-estar bucal. Transforme seu bem-estar: com Wellhub, você tem acesso a academias e atividades físicas em todo lugar. Seu bem-estar mental é nossa prioridade: apoio psicológico disponível. Seja seu melhor com nosso programa de bem-estar, pensado para energizar e inspirar você temos massagem, ginástica laboral e frutas nos escritórios da Cast. Aproveite nosso crédito consignado para realizar seus sonhos com segurança e praticidade. Com o Clube de Descontos economize mais com nossos descontos exclusivos para colaboradores. BENEFÍCIOS FLEXÍVEIS Com a Flash transforme suas despesas em benefícios. Cartão de crédito que simplifica suas despesas;
e pague as contas de água, luz, telefone e internet. Personalize seus benefícios: reembolsos que permitem você escolher o que mais importa: Creche e Educação para os filhos, Cursos, Medicamentos, Terapias, Procedimentos Estéticos, Óculos, Lentes de Contato, Consultas Médicas e Odontológicas (particulares). E TEM MAIS DESENVOLVA SUA CARREIRA Temos a Cast Academy recheada de cursos on-line, e parcerias educacionais para cursos de Graduação e Idiomas (United Idiomas) com super descontos.E aí, topa ser um #CASTLOVER ?

title: Instrutor Mq Series
description: Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance. Estamos com uma oportunidade para o nosso time corporativo para: Instrutor MQ Series. Experiência Profissional Requisitos Experiência Técnica Vasta Experiência com IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ) Experiência sólida** em desenvolvimento COBOL Conhecimento em **ambientes mainframe** (z/OS, CICS, DB2) Experiência com **integração de sistemas** e arquiteturas SOA/ESB Conhecimento em **JCL, copybooks** e estruturas de dados mainframe Experiência em Ensino Vasta ministrando treinamentos técnicos Experiência com **desenvolvimento de material didático** Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara Competências Técnicas Específicas Configuração e administração de Queue Managers** Desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizam MQGET, MQPUT, MQOPEN, MQCLOSE** Conhecimento em MQ Channels, Queues, Topics** Experiência com MQ Explorer** e ferramentas de monitoramento Troubleshooting de problemas de conectividade e performance Conhecimento em MQ Security** (SSL/TLS, autenticação, autorização) Formação Acadêmica Graduação completa. Modelo de trabalho: Remoto: Home office - 100%. Modalidade: PJ Modelo: Home Office Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência. #VemPraSIS #SomosSIS

title: Engenheiro(A) De Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo: O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido. Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão: Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos eestudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração,desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial. Quem você é: Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente. Para este cargo, você precisará: Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançadono pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado. Nossa cultura e compromisso com você: Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios. Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Gerente De Logística
description: Empresa Confidencial está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Logística para liderar a estruturação e gestão das operações logísticas. Este(a) profissional terá papel estratégico, assegurando alinhamento entre as áreas operacionais e comerciais. Como será seu dia a dia de trabalho na empresa? Estruturar, planejar e gerir toda a cadeia logística, abrangendo transporte, armazenagem, movimentação e destinação de materiais e insumos. Atuar de forma descentralizada, coordenando processos e equipes distribuídas em diferentes regiões, assegurando padronização e efetividade. Implementar indicadores de performance logística (custos, produtividade, lead time, disponibilidade de frota, nível de serviço). Conduzir processos de contratação e gestão de fornecedores de transporte, frota e armazenagem, garantindo qualidade e custo competitivo. Apoiar a diretoria na definição de estratégias de expansão e otimização logística nas operações. Integrar-se às áreas Comercial, Operações e demais áreas para garantir fluidez na cadeia de abastecimento e atendimento das metas de entrega. Liderar equipe multidisciplinar, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico, segurança operacional e engajamento da equipe. Representar a área de Logística junto à liderança e órgãos externos, propondo soluções viáveis e sustentáveis. O que é necessário: Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Logística, Supply Chain ou áreas afins será considerado diferencial. Experiência consolidada em gestão de operações logísticas, preferencialmente em indústrias, utilities ou operações ambientais. Conhecimento sólido em gestão de frota, planejamento de rotas, controle de custos logísticos e KPIs. Capacidade de liderança, comunicação clara e atuação colaborativa com áreas técnicas e administrativas. Desejável vivência em contextos de reestruturação organizacional e integração de novas operações. Benefícios: Assistência médica e odontológica, vale refeição e/ou alimentação, seguro de vida, vale transporte e participação nos lucros.

title: Pessoa Engenheira De Software Frontend
description:
Esperamos que você: Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source. O que você vai fazer Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads. Requisitos Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
Vivência com monorepos(ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
Experiência com testesunitários e end-to-end;
Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG). Diferenciais que somam pontos Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
Familiaridadecom CI/CD(ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
Implementaçãoe manutenção de Storybook;
Testes de regressão visual;
Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua. O que oferecemos Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
Colaboração direta comdesigners, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência. Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor Com Foco Em Automações De Processos E Ia
description: O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec, NTSec, InfoSec e CloudSec, empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam. Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), estamos em constante expansão. Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™, temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito. Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua! Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor de novas soluções e integrações com Inteligência Artificial para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos. Responsabilidades e atribuições Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão: Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação. Criar e manter fluxos de automação. Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos. Desenvolver scripts e aplicações utilizando a linguagem de programação Python. Propor e implementar soluções técnicas inovadoras para demandas internas e externas. Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando Power BI (diferencial). Requisitos e qualificações: Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha: Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (completa ou cursando). Experiência sólida com: Ferramentas e frameworks de LLMs, como OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain ,NLP, RAG, Agentes, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, entre outras. Python (Scripting, APIs, integração de sistemas e com banco de dados). HTML/CSS e JavaScript (desenvolvimento web). Plataforma de automação n8n. Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL (Vector Store). Versionamento de código-fonte utilizando Git. Criação e integração de APIs REST/SOAP. Conhecimentos sólidos em modelagem de banco de dados e estruturas SQL. É um diferencial se você tiver: Conhecimentos em Power BI (construção de relatórios e dashboards). Experiência com outras linguagens de automação ou integração de processos (Node.Js, JavaScript, etc). Conhecimento em N8N. E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers ! ⚡

title: Desenvolvedor De.Net Sênior
description: A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Desenvolvedor (a) Aras Innovator com bom nível de idioma inglês para atuar em projetos ágeis de PLM. Atuação 100% remota!Você irá:Atuar no desenvolvimento backend e frontend na plataforma Aras Innovator.Configurar e customizar funcionalidades do Aras conforme necessidades do cliente.Participar de projetos envolvendo Aras Innovator, garantindo aderência a conceitos e processos de PLM.Utilizar práticas ágeis (Scrum/SAFe) em colaboração com times multidisciplinares.Trabalhar com APIs REST e SOAP, integração de sistemas e versionamento de código.  O que buscamos: Experiência em PLM e domínio de Aras Innovator (admin/dev, customização, configuração, projetos com clientes).Conhecimento em REST, SOAP, .Net/C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, MS SQL e Git.Vivência em métodos ágeis (Scrum/SAFe).Inglês avançado.Diferenciais: Proficiência em C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, .NET, MySQL, Git, REST API e CSS.  O que oferecemos:Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!  Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Executivo De Contas
description: Vaga: Executivo(a) de Contas – Agência de Publicidade Local: Recreio dos Bandeirantes / Rio de Janeiro Horário: 9h às 18h / Presencial Regime: PJ Sobre a vaga Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Contas com perfil estratégico, comunicativo e hands-on para integrar nosso time. O profissional será o elo entre cliente e agência, responsável por garantir que as demandas fluam de forma eficiente entre as áreas internas — criação, conteúdo, planejamento, audiovisual e performance — assegurando a qualidade das entregas, o cumprimento de prazos e o alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio dos clientes. Buscamos alguém com visão 360° de marketing e comunicação, capaz de atuar desde o planejamento até a execução de campanhas integradas, com foco em resultados, relacionamento e gestão de projetos. Responsabilidades: Atuar como principal ponto de contato com o cliente, garantindo comunicação clara, empática e estratégica. Gerir o fluxo de projetos junto às áreas internas (criação, audiovisual, conteúdo, mídia, performance e planejamento). Participar do planejamento de campanhas e apresentações estratégicas. Elaborar e acompanhar briefings, cronogramas e entregas junto ao time multidisciplinar. Assegurar a qualidade e coerência das entregas com o posicionamento e a estratégia de cada marca. Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, status e resultados com clientes e equipe interna. Apoiar o time de planejamento na definição de KPIs e análise de resultados de campanhas. Identificar oportunidades de novos projetos e crescimento da conta dentro dos clientes atuais. Requisitos: Experiência comprovada em agências de publicidade (mínimo de 2 anos). Experiência prévia em gestão de projetos com equipe multidisciplinar, atuando entre as áreas criativa, estratégica e operacional. Conhecimento em todas as áreas do marketing: criação, audiovisual, conteúdo, planejamento, mídia e performance. Boa comunicação interpessoal, capacidade de negociação e postura consultiva. Perfil organizado, proativo e orientado a resultados. Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e apresentações (ex: Notion, Canva, PowerPoint). Desejável vivência com clientes do setor varejista ou contas de grande volume de entrega.

title: Gerente De Operações De A&B
description: GERENTE DE OPERAÇÕES DE A&B Somos um hotel dedicado à excelência. Cada detalhe, cada experiência e cada gesto refletem nosso compromisso em oferecer um serviço genuíno, refinado e memorável. Com visão clara, estruturas bem definidas e uma equipe altamente profissional, transformamos qualidade em rotina. Aqui, seu talento encontrará um ambiente sólido, acolhedor e focado no desenvolvimento de pessoas — um lugar onde liderança, inovação e altos padrões caminham juntos para criar resultados extraordinários. Requisitos +5 anos em operações de A&B em hotéis 5★ e experiência com padrões de luxo. Liderança de equipes grandes, com foco em performance e desenvolvimento. Sólido domínio de custos, rentabilidade e KPIs. Experiência em grandes eventos gastronômicos. Liderança voltada à excelência e à experiência do hóspede. Conhecimento em mixologia, vinhos e tendências gastronômicas. Atuação integrada com Cozinha, Stewarding, Compras e RH. Aplicação de práticas de sustentabilidade e ESG. Produção de relatórios e apresentações executivas. Pacote Office avançado e inglês fluente. Benefícios Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos. Convênio Farmácia. Vale transporte. Alimentação no local. Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa. De acordo com o seu “tempo de casa”, você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da empresa, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.

title: Advogada - Propriedade Intelectual
description:
Nosso escritório do Rio de Janeiro busca Estagiário para o time. Se você tem experiência em Contencioso e Tributário, candidate-se a esta oportunidade! Requisitos: Superior Cursando em Direito, a partir do 4º período. Experiência em escritório nas áreas de: Tributário, societário ou contencioso civil;
Necessário inglês avançado ou fluente. Principais Responsabilidades: Realizar o acompanhamento diário de processos judiciais e administrativos em tribunais e órgãos públicos;
Atualizar sistemas internos com informações processuais e de prazos;
Manter o controle de movimentações e publicações relacionadas aos processos. Informações adicionais: Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio de Janeiro Sobre nós Nossa história começou em 1932 e, desde então, acumulamos vasta experiência na prestação de assessoria jurídica a clientes nacionais e internacionais. Somos um escritório de advocacia full service especializado nos setores de infra-estrutura, comércio e logística com destaque em direito marítimo, portos e infraestrutura, energia, óleo e gás, ambiental, ferroviário e setor público com foco em contencioso e arbitragem, tributário e aduaneiro, societário, regulatório, contratual, trabalhista e compliance, Estamos localizados no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brasília e Vitória, com atuação em todo território nacional. Nosso propósito no Kincaid é criar uma equipe multidisciplinar, sempre pronta para entregar as melhores soluções jurídicas para os clientes. Investimos nos nossos profissionais e no ambiente de trabalho buscando sempre o desenvolvimento de uma carreira transformadora! No Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Arquiteto De Dados Empresarial
description:
**Descrição do Cargo** O nosso Engenheiro de Dados Sênior irá desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Inteligência Empresarial e Ciência de Dados. Funções e Responsabilidades Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos utilizando ferramentas de integração de dados;
Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Esquema de Estrela) para otimizar consultas e análises;
Aaltar como referênciatécnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise Empresarial, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade;
Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud;
Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança;
Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados;
CompetênciasEspecíficas Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Inteligência Empresarial;
Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas;
Formação superior completa em áreas correlatas;
Inglês avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação;
Possuir pelo menos umacertificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados;

title: Especialista Em Experiência Digital
description: Como Consultor Sênior, é fundamental para você ajudar nossos clientes a projetar, implementar e otimizar suas experiências digitais. Responsabilidades: Liderança Técnica & Arquitetura Fornecer orientação especializada sobre melhores práticas para modelagem de conteúdo, desenvolvimento de componentes e gerenciamento de ativos digitais na plataforma brXM. Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM. Requisitos Técnicos: Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM). Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security. Sua especialização será crucial para o sucesso do projeto!

title: Academia Sem Barreiras 2025 - Oportunidade Para Pessoas Com Deficiência
description:
Acreditamos que a inovação e a diversidade se conectam. Investimos em nossos talentos para que liderem a verdadeira mudança na sociedade. Buscamos perfis alinhados aos nossos valores. Entusiastas em trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo e dinâmico, com excelência na entrega e inovação presente no dia a dia. Abraçando o poder da mudança para criar valor e sucesso compartilhado para a construção de uma sociedade melhor. Reconhecemos as características únicas dos indivíduos, respeitamos as diferenças e investimos em um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo. Valorizamos todas as competências independentemente de raça, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, credo, deficiência e convicção política. title: Head Of Operations
description: Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents,

description:

In this role, you will take ownership of end-to-end testing strategies, leveraging Python for comprehensive test automation across functional, non-functional, and white-box testing. You will also play a key role in maintaining monitoring systems to proactively identify issues in production environments.


Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable end-to-end (E2E) tests using Python, Playwright, and Pytest for both UI and API validation.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) to support continuous delivery and provide fast feedback.

Test Planning & Strategy

  • Design, document, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.

Functional and Non-Functional Testing

White-box Testing

  • Work closely with developers to understand internal logic and architecture, enabling more effective code-level testing.
  • Utilize Python scripts to facilitate unit, integration, and service-level testing beyond traditional black-box methods.

Monitoring System Configuration

  • Manage application and infrastructure monitoring tools.
  • Establish alerts and dashboards to support proactive issue resolution and maintain uptime.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing.
  • 3+ years of proficiency in Python for test automation, scripting, and framework development.
  • Demonstrable experience with modern testing frameworks/tools like Playwright and Pytest for effective and reliable E2E and API testing.
  • Proven experience working with and testing applications deployed in a Cloud Environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP) .
  • Solid experience setting up and maintaining test execution within CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) .
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Good knowledge of SQL is a must.
  • Familiarity with modern monitoring platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Datadog, or similar).
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.


Nice to have

  • Proficiency in performance and security testing tools (e.g., JMeter, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
  • Experience in testing data pipelines or data warehouse solutions , particularly Amazon Redshift .
  • Familiarity with testing applications built on AI/ML platforms , such as AWS Bedrock (e.g., prompt validation, knowledge base testing, or guardrail evaluation).


What We Offer

  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.

  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.
